newsitem.title: FRANCE: Investors plan French cocoa factory near Rouen.
newsitem.headline: Investors plan French cocoa factory near Rouen.

text.p: A group of investors plans to build a plant near the French port of Rouen to process 60,000 tonnes of cocoa beans imported from west Africa, a local official said on Thursday.

The city council of Grand-Quevilly in the Seine-Maritime department has already approved the sale of land where the factory will be built to Orleans Consulting Group (OCG), deputy mayor and Seine-Maritime senator Marc Massion said.
OCG is working on the project on behalf of several investors whose names have not been disclosed.
Massion said the factory required an investment of some 180 million francs and would create 120 jobs. Production is expected to start at end 1997. OCG officials could not be reached for comments.
